paragraphs.text: Though his enemies were even at hand to destroy him, yet he assures himself that God had ways to deliver him.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: For I am innocent toward them, and have not offended them.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Seeing it belongs to God's judgments to punish the wicked, he desires God to execute his vengeance on the reprobate, who maliciously persecutes his Church.
paragraphs.label: d

paragraphs.text: He compares their cruelty to hungry dogs showing that they are never weary in doing evil.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: They boast openly in their wicked devises, and every word is as a sword: for they neither fear God nor are ashamed of men.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: Though Saul has great power, yet I know that you bridle him: therefore I will patiently hope in you.
paragraphs.label: g

paragraphs.text: He will not fail to help me when need requires.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: Altogether, but little by little, that the people seeing your judgments often, may be mindful of you.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: That in their misery and shame they may be as glasses and examples of God's vengeance.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: When your time will come, and when they have sufficiently served for an example of your vengeance to others.
paragraphs.label: l

paragraphs.text: He mocks their vain enterprises, being assured that they will not bring their purpose to pass.
paragraphs.label: m

paragraphs.text: Who used the policy of a weak woman to confound the enemies strength, 1Sa 19:12.
